reviewSamples.author: Photo of Joe Zampino
reviewSamples.text: This was a nice find it is right off the bike trail. Empanadas are very good, can’t wait to try something else next time. Service also was amazing she gave me a complimentary coffee 😊

reviewSamples.author: Photo of Kevin Harvey
reviewSamples.text: Place was very busy so that was a good sign. Food was amazing and fresh made. This will be a regular spot. Also for the reviews complaining about price, the empanadas are some of the biggest I have ever seen and I could not even finish the …

reviewSamples.author: Photo of Caroline
reviewSamples.text: Amazing customer service! Great variety of Venezuelan food. It is a nice and friendly place! I highly recommend it!

reviewSamples.author: Photo of Nick Sloan
reviewSamples.text: Best Empanadas around Pinellas county! You need to try again and again!

reviewSamples.author: Photo of waleska recio
reviewSamples.text: So delicious! We keep coming back for the cachapas and everyone we bring always loves them. We’ve tried the one with shredded beef, shredded pork and the regular one. Always a hit!
